trello_card.description:
## Griffin Gaming Partners - VC Outreach Packet

### Fund Overview
- **Fund Name:** Griffin Gaming Partners (GGP)
- **Location:** Santa Monica, California
- **AUM:** $1.5 billion under management (world's largest gaming-exclusive VC)
- **Stage Focus:** Seed through growth equity
- **Check Size:** $1M - $50M+

### Investment Thesis
Griffin is singularly focused on investing in the global gaming market across:
- Game content (studios & publishers)
- Gaming platforms & infrastructure
- Social/community features
- Game technology & tools
- Esports & competitive gaming

**Investment Areas:**
- Content: Studios building breakthrough games
- Platforms: Social features, community tools, infrastructure
- Software: Game engines, dev tools, live ops tech

**AI/Gaming Infrastructure Alignment:** VERY HIGH
- Founded by industry veterans with deep infrastructure expertise
- Portfolio includes Discord, AppLovin, Overwolf (major gaming infrastructure plays)
- Active interest in AI/ML for gaming applications
- Venture Partner Doug Bemis (PhD, former Uber AI Labs) leads AI initiatives

### Key Partner: Nick Tuosto
- **Title:** Managing Director & Co-Founder
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/nick-tuosto/
- **Email:** nick@griffingp.com (inferred)
- **Background:** Has advised on major gaming M&A: Tencent/Supercell, Kabam/Netmarble, FoxNext/Scopely, AppLovin/MZ, Phoenix Labs/Garena, Roblox, PlayStudios, AT&T/Playdemic, Take-Two/Zynga
- **Expertise:** Gaming M&A, strategic advisory, deal execution

**Co-Founders (also good targets):**
- **Peter Levin** - Former President of Interactive Ventures at Lionsgate, Co-founder of Nerdist Industries, early advisor to Rovio (Angry Birds)
- **Phil Sanderson** - 23 years gaming VC experience; investments include Discord, Phoenix Labs, Vivox, Triller, Funzio

### Notable Portfolio Companies
**Infrastructure/Platform:**
- **Discord** - Gaming communication platform ($10B+ valuation)
- **AppLovin** - Mobile marketing & monetization platform (public)
- **Overwolf** - In-game apps & creator platform
- **Forte** - Blockchain gaming infrastructure
- **WinZO** - Social gaming platform (India)

**Content:**
- **Spyke Games** - Mobile game studio
- **One Rule Games** - Game development
- **Wavedash** - Gaming/esports
- **Giant** - Educational gaming

### Recent Activity
- Fund III active deployment
- Recently expanded team with new investors and operating partners
- Active in both North America and international markets
- Strong track record of follow-on rounds and strategic exits

### Outreach Angle
**Primary Hook:** Gaming infrastructure - Griffin literally wrote the book on gaming VC and has the best infrastructure portfolio in the industry (Discord, AppLovin, Overwolf). They deeply understand gaming tech stacks.

**Secondary Hooks:**
1. Reference their infrastructure portfolio (Discord, AppLovin, Overwolf)
2. Nick's M&A expertise - they know all the buyers
3. Founder-friendly approach - they

4. AI angle through Doug Bemis (AI Venture Partner)
5. Santa Monica-based (strong LA gaming connection)

### Outreach Strategy
1. Lead with gaming infrastructure expertise acknowledgment
2. Reference specific portfolio companies that align with our space
3. Emphasize platform/infrastructure (not competing with their content investments)
4. Request intro with Nick given M&A background

### Unique Value Proposition
Griffin is THE gaming VC - if they don't understand the value of gaming infrastructure, no one will. They have:
- Deepest gaming network
- Best track record in gaming VC
- Most relevant portfolio for infrastructure validation
- LionTree as strategic partner (elite media M&A)

### Resources
- Website: https://griffingp.com
- Team: https://griffingp.com/ggp-team/
- Portfolio: https://griffingp.com/ggp-portfolio/
